question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food for a day?
premises: Non-eating is practiced for a day
This practice leads to a specific outcome
The outcome is described as going to age-death
inference: By not eating for a day, one will go to the death of age.
uncertainties: vayo-mṛtyuṃ may mean death due to age or the end of aging; translation follows the compound literally
plain_english: By not eating for a day, one will go to death by age.
